1. Park your car near another vehicle with a working battery. Make sure both cars are off and in neutral or park. 2. Connect the red clamp of the jumper cable to the positive terminal of the dead battery. 3. Connect the other red clamp to the positive terminal of the good battery. 4. Connect the black clamp to the negative terminal of the good battery. 5. Connect the other black clamp to a metal part of the engine block of the car with the dead battery, not directly to the battery.
